_comment: Reference data the policy reads as `data.register` and `data.tools`.
The register lists each agent with the tools it may reach and the autonomy tier the owner
assigned it. The tool table says what each tool does, which is what a rule written on the
effect of a call needs: `read_only`, `creates_work_order`, and for the specific tool the
work order type it always creates. A rule can only say what this table lets it distinguish.
`aqx policy apply` loads each top-level key into the policy engine; `opa test policy/` reads
this file from the directory. The two must agree, so there is one file.
